annotation.title_clean: Acuerdo PCSJA24-12243 – Por el cual se adoptan lineamientos para el uso y aprovechamiento respetuoso, responsable, seguro y ético de la inteligencia artificial en la Rama Judicial
annotation.title_en: Agreement PCSJA24-12243 – Adopting guidelines for the respectful, responsible, safe and ethical use of artificial intelligence in the Judicial Branch
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Binding agreement of Colombia's Superior Council of the Judiciary setting guidelines for judicial officers' use of AI, especially generative AI. It sets principles, permitted and restricted uses, duties, disclosure obligations, institutional implementation requirements, training and monitoring. AI must not replace human judicial reasoning.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI must not replace judicial reasoning, evidence assessment or decisions; officials remain responsible
Tiered permitted uses: administrative, uses needing detailed review, uses needing special transparency
Mandatory disclosure of generative AI use, including tool, provider, date and prompts
Ban on entering personal or confidential data into tools that reuse it, and on free general chatbots
Institutional projects require algorithmic and privacy impact analysis, training and reporting
